Name the memories you want verified (up to 2, or none) and state the

answer.rationale: The two live symptoms are onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%), and onboarding friction is plausibly upstream of both, so friction reduction addresses the causal root rather than one downstream symptom. Promotional pricing is the obvious reflex against the competitor's entry pricing, but memory_73 is the clearest record we have of a funnel win that destroyed value: signups +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%, weak renewals. Against a primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue, matching a discount war would buy exactly the wrong cohort. Enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) is credible but does not touch either regression and cannot absorb the SMB pressure. Activation messaging (memory_91) is my fallback, but it reports week-one engagement and 'first meaningful action' only — an early-funnel proxy. Critically, the same weakness afflicts my chosen direction: memory_31 and memory_86 both report activation, completion, and time-to-value, and neither reports retention or revenue. That is structurally the same shape as memory_73 before its retention cost was known — reducing required fields and shortening onboarding can raise completion while lowering the qualification quality and commitment of the accounts that complete. So I am spending both verification pulls on my own preferred direction rather than on the alternative: I want the original records for memory_86 and memory_31 specifically to see whether the lifts were ever tracked past week one to renewal, and whether lead-quality or field-completeness metrics moved. Verifying the option I already intend to take is more informative than verifying the one I would only fall back to. If the archive shows these were completion-only measurements with no durable revenue follow-through, the 'durable lift' language in memory_31 is overstated and I shift to activation_messaging, which at least targets the larger regression without stripping qualification data. Because the downstream value risk is real and unresolved, I am scoping this as a small guarded test with retention, renewal, and qualified-pipeline instrumentation from day one, not a broad rollout — the funnel metric alone must not be allowed to declare victory. The one-week slot pressures toward a bigger swing, but an unfalsified assumption scaled broadly is how memory_73 happened.
